hardwareHubs.note: NASA's Marshall Space Flight Center is in Huntsville, which anchors the area's aerospace and defense hardware work.
Airbus's only U.S. manufacturing facility is in Mobile and produces A320 Family and A220 jets.

makerspaces.name: Makers Local 256
makerspaces.note: Nonprofit makerspace in the Five Points area with laser cutters, 3D printers, soldering stations and woodworking tools.

makerspaces.name: Bulldog Makerspace FabLab
makerspaces.note: Alabama A&M University lab listing 3D printing, CNC milling, circuit production, laser and vinyl cutting.

makerspaces.name: Huntsville-Madison County Public Library Makerspace Studios
makerspaces.note: Library studios with 3D printers, and a desktop CNC at some branches.

programs.name: gBETA Huntsville (gener8tor)
programs.note: Free seven-week no-equity accelerator for early-stage companies, not specific to hardware.

programs.name: Auburn University New Venture Accelerator
programs.note: Auburn Research Park program that gives startups space and helps faculty commercialize research.

specialties.name: Aerospace and defense
specialties.note: The state reports 300+ aerospace companies, with Lockheed Martin and Dynetics developing hypersonic missiles.

specialties.name: Automotive
specialties.note: Mercedes-Benz, Honda, Hyundai, Toyota and Mazda operate large facilities and the sector employs over 40,000 workers.

specialties.name: Shipbuilding
specialties.note: Mobile County shipyards such as Master Boat Builders are expanding fabrication capacity.

support.name: Alabama Technology Network (ATN)
support.note: Alabama's NIST MEP center, part of the Alabama Community College System, offering technical assistance, lean and quality methods, and training to manufacturers.
